anyOf.description: Identifier of an active resource belonging to the selected organization and readable by the caller.

runtime__organization_defaults_patch.description: Supply one or more defaults. Omitted properties preserve existing values; null explicitly clears a default. All references are validated before any changes are saved.

runtime__organization_defaults.description: Saved defaults for the selected organization. Unset defaults are null. A saved reference can become unavailable after it is set; creation forms must check current resource eligibility before applying it.
